text.tspan: Module 1 — Choreography · EventBridge events, no central controller
Agents never call each other — they announce domain events on travel-agents-bus and the next agent reacts.
Dead-letter queue — every agent Lambda has an SQS DLQ for failed invocations
Deterministic gates: RAIN_THRESHOLD=60% in weather.py decides PROCEED/RECONSIDER · the LLM only writes prose
